correlated_scalar.sql: select (select h.monthly_income_mdc), (select h.household_id) from household_survey h

lateral_leak.sql: select x from household_survey h, lateral (select h.monthly_income_mdc as x)

lateral_whole_row.sql: select s from household_survey h, lateral (select h as s)

cte_shadow.sql: select monthly_income_mdc from household_survey, (with household_survey as (select 1 x) select x from household_survey) s

join_multiplies.sql: select h.household_id, avg(h.monthly_income_mdc) from household_survey h, range(10) r group by h.household_id

self_join_multiplies.sql: select a.household_id, avg(a.monthly_income_mdc) from household_survey a join household_survey b on true group by 1

arbitrary_fn.sql: select region_code, arbitrary(household_id), arbitrary(monthly_income_mdc) from household_survey group by region_code

quantile_disc_max.sql: select region_code, quantile_disc(monthly_income_mdc, 1) from household_survey group by region_code

approx_top_k_fn.sql: select region_code, approx_top_k(monthly_income_mdc, 3) from household_survey group by region_code

arg_max_null_fn.sql: select region_code, arg_max_null(monthly_income_mdc, respondent_age) from household_survey group by region_code

unknown_scalar.sql: select region_code, sha256(household_id::varchar) from household_survey group by all

rounded_avg.sql: select region_code, round(avg(monthly_income_mdc)) as mean_income from household_survey group by all order by 1

avg_of_case.sql: select region_code, avg(case when monthly_income_mdc > 4000 then 1 else 0 end) as share from household_survey group by 1

banded_group.sql: select floor(respondent_age / 10) * 10 as age_band, count(*) as n, median(monthly_income_mdc) as m from household_survey group by 1

aggregate_then_join.sql: with s as (select region_code, avg(monthly_income_mdc) as income from household_survey group by 1) select g.region_code, s.income, max(g.load_mw) as peak from grid_load g join s using (region_code) group by 1, 2

nested_own_table.sql: select region_code, count(*) as n from household_survey where region_code in (select region_code from household_survey group by 1 having avg(monthly_income_mdc) > 3000) group by 1

open_join.sql: select h.region_code, count(*) as n, max(g.load_mw) as peak from household_survey h join grid_load g using (region_code) group by 1
